title: Pathfinding Primer
scenario: Welcome to Pathfinding. You must understand Administrative Distance (AD) - the router's trust ranking for routing sources. Lower AD = more trusted. Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) is a link-state protocol with AD 110. Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) is a Cisco hybrid protocol with AD 90. Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routes between autonomous systems with AD 20 (eBGP) or 200 (iBGP).
question: Which routing protocol has the lowest default AD (most trusted)?
explanation: External BGP (eBGP) has AD 20, making it the most trusted among these options.
